text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer. Could you take a look 
at this for a sec?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"During the break, you see, Falco-san took 
me to one of those 'aesthetic photo 
cafes'~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I tried taking a selfie too, ya know. It 
was tricky though, so only half my face 
made it in."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd love to go again. We can enjoy a 
delicious parfait and give taking selfies 
another try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Wonder Acute had a truly 
fulfilling day off!
